info.title: Custoking item order workflows
info.description: One workflow engine for every item (design: docs/product/item-order-workflows-sop-v1.md section 3.5). A schema with x-ims-java-record names the Java record that serializes or binds it (source file and record name, nested records by their simple name). Its properties are listed in record-component order and must stay so; a nullable property is a Java reference type, an enum property a Java enum or a String holding one of the listed values. The generator refuses a schema whose record components drift.

get.summary: Order workflow list and board (superadmin, or operators with notebook-tracker:read in their school and item scope)

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Comma-separated item codes, e.g. NB,FE; omitted means every item

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Current step code

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: me, unassigned, or a user id (superadmin)

parameters.name: sla
parameters.description: The active step's SLA state (SlaState), or DUE_TODAY: due on today's date in the school's time zone, overdue or not (the dueToday count)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the order number, CK id or school name

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: due (default; overdue first), placed (newest first) or number

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Default 50

OrderWorkflowError.description: The body of a refused request. Plain refusals carry only message.

code.description: Stable code: GATE_UNMET, STEP_NOT_EDITABLE, STEP_NOT_ACTIVE, HEAD_APPROVAL_STALE, NOT_ASSIGNEE, SUPERADMIN_ONLY, INVALID_STEP_DATA, NOTE_TOO_LONG, INVALID_INVITE, ...

unmet.description: Present with GATE_UNMET: every requirement still missing

Phase.description: Board column / stage group: Intake & design, Planning, Production, Verification, Delivery

SlaState.description: OVERDUE: past due; DUE_SOON: due within 4 hours; ON_TRACK: has a deadline further away; NO_TIMER: no deadline (no SLA, or finished)

Tab.description: Stage tabs: Work area, School & vendor, Checklist, Activity history

FieldKind.description: TEXT (max characters), WORDS (max words, 4,000-character cap), URL (https only, <= 1,000), DATE (yyyy-mm-dd), WHOLE (integer), NUMBER, CHOICE

orderId.description: CK id; the key in every path

orderNumber.description: SOP order number, e.g. NB-DPS_GUR-26-11-13-0042; null until school-core has minted it

itemCode.description: Item code, e.g. NB, FE, BBK

customised.description: False for a wholesale notebook order (Steps 2-4 skipped)

orderedCount.description: Total quantity ordered (sum of the placed lines)

timeZone.description: The school's IANA zone; deadlines and dates are shown in it

phase.description: Phase of the current step; the last step's phase once finished

currentStep.description: Order of the active step; null once finished

assigneeUserId.description: Assignee of the active step (the point of contact); null when unassigned or finished

assigneeName.description: Full name from identity; null when unknown

dueAt.description: Deadline of the active step; null without a timer

total.description: Steps on this order's path (12, 9 for wholesale notebooks, or 9)

OrderWorkflowCounts.description: Summary chips. Counted over every unfinished order in the caller's scope that matches the item and schoolId filters; the other filters and paging do not change them.

open.description: Unfinished orders the caller may see

dueToday.description: Active step due today in the school's time zone, overdue or not; sla=DUE_TODAY lists them

mine.description: Active step assigned to the caller

total.description: Rows matching every filter, before paging

Sla.description: A time slot: 24/7 calendar hours, or Monday-Friday working days.

banner.description: Amber banner shown until the sign-off exists

items.description: Verbatim item labels; saved data stores ticked zero-based indexes

signOffItem.description: Zero-based index of the item only the sign-off ticks (NB Step 7 item 8 = 7); null otherwise

max.description: TEXT: max characters; WORDS: max words; WHOLE/NUMBER: largest value; null for no limit beyond the kind's own

choices.description: CHOICE: [value, label] pairs in display order; null otherwise

legacy.description: Accepted on save and kept, but only shown read-only under "Earlier details"

fields.description: FIELDS_PRESENT: the fields that must be saved

except.description: ALL_CHECKED: zero-based items not required (e.g. the sign-off item)

categories.description: VENDORS_SELECTED: each listed category needs a vendor; null means any one category

title.description: Card title; null uses the block type's default

fields.description: FIELDS / ORDER_PDF_LINK / LEGACY_DETAILS: the step fields the card shows, in order; INTRO_MESSAGE: the one TEXT field the tick saves the message as sent into

save.description: Card-level save button label, e.g. "Save QC evidence"

categories.description: VENDOR_DIRECTORY / VENDOR_SELECTION / VENDOR_GROUPS: vendor categories shown; null means all (selection: all 18; groups: every selected vendor)

suggestedByItem.description: VENDOR_SELECTION: item code -> categories listed first and expanded

code.description: Also the order status while this step is active

defaultSla.description: Current default time slot (superadmin-editable); null means no SLA. The template file may spell it "sla".

icon.description: lucide-react icon name for the stage tile, e.g. "ShieldCheck"

superadminCompletes.description: Only superadmin may complete this step (Head Approval)

introMessage.description: SOP introduction text with {Name} (and {Item} in the General template), filled by the browser

steps.description: Every step of the template; a wholesale order's path omits customisedOnly steps

defaultSla.description: The template step's default; null means no SLA

effective.description: What this school's orders use: the school override (source SCHOOL) or the default (DEFAULT); null means no timer

message.description: What is missing, e.g. "Save the controlled storage link"

canEdit.description: May save data and tick checklists on this step now (D18)

canComplete.description: May complete now; the screen also needs unmet to be empty

stepOrder.description: Set for a stage note; null for an order-level internal note

startedAt.description: When the clock started: placement for Step 1, else when the previous step completed or the step was reopened

data.description: Saved field values and checklist index lists, keyed as in the template; never holds the sign-off record

unmet.description: On the ACTIVE step: every requirement Complete still needs; empty otherwise

version.description: Send back as expectedVersion on step actions

canClaim.description: An eligible operator and the order is unassigned ("Take this order")

canSelectVendors.description: Superadmin, or the Production Planning assignee while it is active

canSetSchoolGroup.description: Superadmin or the current-step assignee (item-level group link)

canLogCall.description: Anyone who can work the order

canAddNote.description: Anyone who can work the order

canApproveDesign.description: Superadmin, while Head Approval is active

comment.description: The Head Approval comment (approve or request changes)

approvedCdrLink.description: The CDR Conversion link the approval binds to; a different saved link makes the approval stale

schoolContactPhone.description: Null until saved; the screen prefills the school record's phone

UpcomingAction.description: A derived "Live list" row (D39); at most 6 per order.

url.description: https://chat.whatsapp.com/... invite, or null when none is saved

source.description: School group: ITEM override, else SCHOOL. Internal approval: SCHOOL (per-school), else GLOBAL

vendors.description: The order's selected vendors (any category, inactive ones included), each with its own group link

VendorSummary.description: A vendor as stage cards and the call log show it. Declared in VendorLookup.java (seam of section 3.4).

categories.description: Vendor category codes this vendor belongs to

phone.description: Required for real vendors; null only on sample vendors

whatsappGroupUrl.description: The vendor's own WhatsApp group invite (https://chat.whatsapp.com/...), or null

sample.description: A seeded prototype vendor with no phone ("Sample")

active.description: False for a deactivated vendor an order selected before; shown as "Inactive"

OrderWorkflowView.description: Everything the order workflow screen needs for one order, filtered to what the caller may see and do.

assigneeUserId.description: Point of contact: the active step's assignee

vendorSelections.description: Vendor category code -> selected vendor ids

internalNotes.description: Order-level internal notes, newest first, at most the latest 3; Activity history has all

now.description: Server time, for clock-skew correction of live timers

version.description: Order-level version: expectedVersion of vendor selections

steps.description: The steps on this order's path, in order

data.description: A partial save: fields sent replace, null or blank clears, fields left out keep their value. Checklists are lists of zero-based indexes

expectedVersion.description: The version of the step being reopened

comment.description: Required justification; at most 100 words and 1,000 characters (workflow_notebook_trackers.design_comment)

expectedVersion.description: The Head Approval step's version as loaded

userId.description: An operator eligible for the order's school and category

selections.description: Vendor category code -> vendor ids; replaces every selection; empty lists are dropped

designerId.description: A designer from the directory; null clears it

stepOrder.description: Set for a stage note ("Save activity note"); omit for an order-level internal note

active.description: Omitted or null keeps the designer active

SlaRequest.description: value and unit go together. For a school override both null means "no timer for this school and step"; a template default needs both.

url.description: https://chat.whatsapp.com/... invite; blank or null removes the link

contactLabel.description: Who was called, at most 200 characters; filled from the vendor or designer when one is picked and this is blank

vendorId.description: A vendor selected on this order

notes.description: At most 100 words; required for DELAY_REPORTED, CHANGES_REQUESTED and CALLBACK_REQUESTED

action.description: ACTION: the workflow_actions code (STEP_COMPLETED, STEP_DATA_SAVED, HEAD_APPROVED, VENDORS_SELECTED, ...); null otherwise

at.description: When it happened; for a group, the latest entry

text.description: Note body, call notes, or the action's reason/comment

details.description: Kind-specific facts: changed field names and checklist counts, call contacted/outcome/contactLabel/nextFollowUpAt, follow-up percentComplete/nextFollowUpOn, ...

count.description: Grouped consecutive saves by one person on one stage within 10 minutes; 1 otherwise

nextBefore.description: Pass as before to read older entries; null when there are none

inviteUrl.description: https://chat.whatsapp.com/<10-64 characters>; blank or null removes the link
The global internal approval group; null when not set
